summary: Official registration card establishing educational seniority for state government employment drives.

steps.title: Register on National Career Service (NCS)
steps.description: Create jobseeker profile with Aadhaar, education qualification certificates, and technical skills.

steps.title: Upload experience and category certificates
steps.description: Add vocational certifications (ITI, Polytechnic) and caste/disability certificates for reservation.

steps.title: Download Employment Exchange Card
steps.description: Receive NCS Jobseeker Registration Number and digital employment card.

steps.title: Participate in government job fairs
steps.description: Receive automated SMS invitations to Rozgar Melas and state vacancy notifications.
